mechanics.claim: Rumble activates a flamethrower that continually deals magic damage in a frontal cone for the duration, ticking every 0.25s.
mechanics.quote: activates a flamethrower for a short time that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} in a frontal cone

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins counting down on cast, not when the flamethrower ends.
Enemies hit by the flame take damage on each tick and also on initial hit if not currently scorched, with the debuff refreshing on subsequent hits.
mechanics.quote: taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently scorched, refreshing on subsequent inflictions

mechanics.claim: When the debuff is newly applied (not refreshed), the target takes one additional instance of the debuff, delayed by 0.1 seconds, effectively dealing extra damage on first application.
mechanics.quote: the target is dealt one additional instance of the debuff at the same time as the application. This is done by delaying the actual debuff by {{fd|0.1}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: While in the Danger Zone (overheated), Flamespitter's damage is increased by 50%.
mechanics.quote: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Flamespitter's'' damage is increased.

mechanics.claim: Flamespitter's damage against monsters is capped based on a scaling formula, but no such cap applies to champions.
mechanics.quote: ''Flamespitter's'' total damage based on the target's health is capped at ... against {{tip|monsters}}.
